76.name: Cable Shrug
76.description: Stand tall and shrug the shoulders straight up against cable resistance.

77.name: Barbell Shrug
77.description: Hold the bar with straight arms and raise the shoulders without rolling them.

78.name: Dumbbell Shrug
78.description: Hold dumbbells at the sides and lift the shoulders under control.

79.name: Standing Dumbbell Upright Row
79.description: Pull the dumbbells toward the upper chest while keeping the elbows high.

80.name: Barbell Upright Row
80.description: Pull the bar close to the body toward the upper chest with high elbows.

81.name: Cable Lateral Raise
81.description: Raise one arm out to the side against cable resistance without shrugging.

82.name: Machine Lateral Raise
82.description: Raise the machine pads out to the sides while keeping the torso still.

83.name: Dumbbell Lateral Raise
83.description: Raise the dumbbells out to shoulder height with softly bent elbows.

84.name: Standing Military Press
84.description: Press the bar overhead from shoulder level while keeping the trunk braced.

85.name: Seated Barbell Military Press
85.description: Press the bar overhead from a seated, supported position.

86.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
86.description: Press the dumbbells overhead and lower them to shoulder level with control.

87.name: Machine Shoulder Press
87.description: Press the machine handles overhead while keeping the back supported.

88.name: Reverse Pec Deck Fly
88.description: Open the arms against the pads to train the rear shoulders and upper back.

89.name: Seated Bent-Over Rear Delt Raise
89.description: Hinge forward while seated and raise the dumbbells out to the sides.

90.name: Barbell Bench Press
90.description: Lower the bar to the chest and press it up from a stable bench position.

91.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
91.description: Press dumbbells above the upper chest on an inclined bench.

92.name: Pec Deck Fly
92.description: Bring the machine arms together in front of the chest without rounding forward.

93.name: Machine Chest Press
93.description: Press the machine handles forward while keeping the shoulders supported.

94.name: Cable Crossover
94.description: Bring the cable handles together in front of the chest with a soft elbow bend.

95.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
95.description: Press dumbbells above the chest from a flat bench with controlled depth.

96.name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
96.description: Lower the bar toward the upper chest and press from an inclined bench.

97.name: Dumbbell Fly
97.description: Open the dumbbells in a wide arc and bring them together above the chest.

98.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
98.description: Perform a controlled dumbbell fly on an inclined bench.

99.name: Smith Machine Bench Press
99.description: Press the Smith machine bar from the chest on a flat bench.

100.name: Smith Machine Incline Bench Press
100.description: Press the Smith machine bar from the upper chest on an inclined bench.

101.name: Incline Machine Chest Press
101.description: Press the machine handles forward and upward to target the upper chest.

102.name: Decline Barbell Bench Press
102.description: Lower the bar to the lower chest and press from a declined bench.

103.name: Push-Up
103.description: Lower the braced body toward the floor and press back to straight arms.

104.name: Bent-Arm Dumbbell Pullover
104.description: Lower one dumbbell behind the head with bent elbows and pull it over the chest.

105.name: Pull-Up
105.description: Pull the chest toward the bar from a full, controlled hang.

106.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
106.description: Pull the wide bar toward the upper chest while keeping the torso stable.

107.name: Close-Grip V-Bar Pulldown
107.description: Pull the V-bar toward the chest with the elbows driving down.

108.name: Chin-Up
108.description: Pull up with an underhand grip until the chin clears the bar.

109.name: Behind-the-Neck Wide-Grip Pulldown
109.description: Pull the wide bar carefully behind the head only through a comfortable range.

110.name: Rope Straight-Arm Pulldown
110.description: Keep the arms nearly straight and pull the rope from overhead toward the thighs.

111.name: Single-Arm Hammer Pulldown
111.description: Pull one lever down toward the ribs while keeping the torso supported.

112.name: Two-Arm Hammer Pulldown
112.description: Pull both machine levers toward the ribs with the chest supported.

113.name: Hammer Curl
113.description: Curl the dumbbells with neutral palms while keeping the upper arms still.

114.name: Preacher Curl
114.description: Curl the weight while the upper arms stay supported on the preacher pad.

115.name: Dumbbell Hammer Preacher Curl
115.description: Use a neutral grip to curl dumbbells from the preacher pad.

116.name: Barbell Curl
116.description: Curl the bar toward the shoulders without swinging the torso.

117.name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
117.description: Curl dumbbells from an inclined bench while keeping the upper arms behind the torso.

118.name: Standing Cable Curl
118.description: Curl the cable handle toward the shoulders with the elbows fixed.

119.name: Concentration Curl
119.description: Brace the upper arm against the thigh and curl the dumbbell slowly.

120.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl
120.description: Curl the dumbbells toward the shoulders without moving the upper arms.

121.name: Seated Dumbbell Curl
121.description: Curl dumbbells from a seated position while keeping the torso upright.

122.name: Zottman Curl
122.description: Curl with palms up, rotate at the top, and lower with palms down.

123.name: Overhead Straight-Bar Cable Triceps Extension
123.description: Extend the elbows overhead using a straight cable attachment.

124.name: Overhead Rope Triceps Extension
124.description: Extend the elbows overhead and separate the rope at full extension.

125.name: Single-Arm Cable Triceps Extension
125.description: Straighten one elbow against cable resistance without moving the upper arm.

126.name: Standing Dumbbell Overhead Triceps Extension
126.description: Lower a dumbbell behind the head and extend the elbows overhead.

127.name: Triceps Pushdown
127.description: Push the cable attachment down until the elbows are straight.

128.name: EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
128.description: Lower the EZ-bar toward the forehead by bending only the elbows.

129.name: Lying Dumbbell Triceps Extension
129.description: Lower the dumbbells beside the head and extend the elbows.

130.name: Chest Dip
130.description: Lean slightly forward, lower between the bars, and press back up.

131.name: Seated Palms-Up Dumbbell Wrist Curl
131.description: Curl the wrists upward with the forearms supported and palms facing up.

132.name: Seated Palms-Down Dumbbell Wrist Curl
132.description: Raise the backs of the hands with the forearms supported and palms down.

133.name: Ab Crunch Machine
133.description: Curl the rib cage toward the pelvis against the machine resistance.

134.name: Decline Crunch
134.description: Curl the upper back off a declined bench without pulling on the neck.

135.name: Seated Cable Row
135.description: Pull the handle toward the torso while keeping the spine stable.

136.name: Bent-Over Barbell Row
136.description: Hinge at the hips and row the bar toward the lower ribs.

137.name: Machine Glute Bridge
137.description: Drive the hips up against the machine pad and squeeze the glutes.

138.name: Hip Abductor Machine
138.description: Press the knees outward against the pads without rocking the torso.

139.name: Leg Extension
139.description: Extend the knees against the machine pad and lower under control.

140.name: Hack Squat
140.description: Lower on the hack squat platform and drive through the feet to stand.

141.name: Smith Machine Squat
141.description: Squat under the guided bar while keeping the feet firmly planted.

142.name: Hip Adductor Machine
142.description: Bring the knees together against the pads without bouncing.

143.name: Glute-Ham Raise
143.description: Lower the torso from the knees and pull back up with the hamstrings.

144.name: Lying Leg Curl
144.description: Curl the machine pad toward the glutes while keeping the hips down.

145.name: Seated Calf Raise
145.description: Raise the heels against the thigh pad and lower through a full range.

146.name: Cable Wrist Curl
146.description: Curl the wrists against cable resistance while keeping the forearms still.

147.name: Palms-Down Wrist Curl Over a Bench
147.description: Raise the backs of the hands while the forearms rest across a bench.

148.name: Palms-Up Barbell Wrist Curl Over a Bench
148.description: Curl the bar with the wrists while the forearms rest across a bench.

149.name: Oblique Crunch
149.description: Curl the torso diagonally to bring the ribs toward the opposite hip.

150.name: Hanging Leg Raise
150.description: Raise the legs from a controlled hang without swinging.

151.name: Lying Bench Leg Raise
151.description: Raise the legs from a flat bench while keeping the lower back controlled.

152.name: Crunch
152.description: Curl the rib cage toward the pelvis while keeping the lower back grounded.

153.name: Decline Sit-Up
153.description: Raise the torso from a declined bench with the abdomen braced.

154.name: Cable Crunch
154.description: Kneel and curl the torso down against cable resistance.

155.name: Chest-Supported T-Bar Row
155.description: Row the T-bar toward the chest while keeping the torso supported.

156.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
156.description: Brace the body and row one dumbbell toward the hip.

157.name: Bent-Over Two-Dumbbell Row
157.description: Hinge at the hips and row both dumbbells toward the ribs.

158.name: Single-Leg Cable Kickback
158.description: Drive one leg back against cable resistance without arching the lower back.

159.name: Machine Glute Kickback
159.description: Press one leg back against the machine pad and squeeze the glute.

160.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
160.description: Drive the hips up with the upper back supported and the bar across the hips.

161.name: Smith Machine Hip Thrust
161.description: Drive the guided bar upward with the upper back supported.

162.name: Leg Press
162.description: Lower the platform under control and press through the whole foot.

163.name: Barbell Squat
163.description: Squat with the bar securely positioned and drive up through the feet.

164.name: Dumbbell Lunge
164.description: Step into a lunge with dumbbells at the sides and push back to standing.

165.name: Smith Machine Lunge
165.description: Lunge under the guided bar while keeping the front foot firmly planted.

166.name: Smith Machine Single-Leg Split Squat
166.description: Perform a split squat under the guided bar with emphasis on the front leg.

167.name: Seated Leg Curl
167.description: Curl the machine pad down and back while keeping the hips seated.

168.name: Romanian Deadlift
168.description: Hinge at the hips with a soft knee bend and keep the weight close.

169.name: Conventional Deadlift
169.description: Lift the bar from the floor with a braced trunk and balanced foot pressure.

170.name: Stiff-Leg Dumbbell Deadlift
170.description: Hinge forward with nearly straight legs while keeping the dumbbells close.

171.name: Sumo Deadlift
171.description: Lift from a wide stance with the knees tracking over the toes.

172.name: Calf Press on Leg Press
172.description: Press the platform through the balls of the feet using ankle movement only.

173.name: Standing Calf Raise
173.description: Rise onto the balls of the feet and lower the heels under control.

174.name: Alternating Kettlebell Floor Press
174.description: Starting position: lie on the floor with two kettlebells held above the chest. Movement: lower one kettlebell to the chest while the other stays locked out, then press it back up. Return: alternate sides with control.

175.name: Kettlebell Renegade Row
175.description: Starting position: hold a wide-foot plank on two kettlebells, keeping the body in one straight line. Movement: brace one bell on the floor and row the other toward the waist, drawing the elbow back. Return: lower it under control and alternate sides without twisting the hips.

176.name: Bench-Supported Barbell Rollout
176.description: Starting position: kneel on a bench and hold a loaded barbell on the floor with straight arms and a braced core. Movement: roll the bar forward as the hips extend, without letting the low back sag. Return: pull the bar back with the abdominals from a comfortable stretched position.

177.name: Seated Barbell Calf Raise
177.description: Starting position: sit on a bench with the balls of the feet on a block and a barbell secured across the thighs above the knees. Movement: raise the heels as high as possible. Return: pause at the top, then lower the heels slowly into a full calf stretch.

178.name: Behind-the-Back Barbell Shrug
178.description: Starting position: stand tall holding a barbell behind the body with straight arms. Movement: raise the shoulders toward the ears without bending the elbows. Return: lower the shoulders slowly and under control.

179.name: Barbell Side Bend
179.description: Starting position: stand with a barbell across the upper back, as for a squat. Movement: keep the back straight and bend at the waist to one side while the rest of the body stays still. Return: come upright and repeat to the other side.

180.name: Barbell Side Squat
180.description: Starting position: stand wide with a barbell across the upper back and turn the working foot outward. Movement: sit toward the working leg by bending its hip and knee while the other leg stays only slightly bent. Return: drive through the working leg and repeat on the other side.

181.name: Body-Up Push-Up
181.description: Starting position: hold a forearm plank with the torso rigid and straight. Movement: press from the forearms onto the hands into a high plank without letting the hips sag or rise. Return: lower one forearm and then the other back to the floor.

182.name: Lying Hip Raise
182.description: Starting position: lie on the back with straight legs and arms by the sides. Movement: draw the knees in, extend the legs upward, then curl the pelvis to lift the glutes from the floor. Return: lower the pelvis and legs slowly to the start.

183.name: Bradford Press
183.description: Starting position: sit with a barbell at shoulder level in a wide overhand grip. Movement: press overhead, lower carefully behind the head only through a comfortable range, then press overhead again. Return: lower to the front of the shoulders and alternate front and back lowers.

184.name: Cable Crossover Deadlift
184.description: Starting position: stand between low cable pulleys, hinge down to the handles with a neutral back and lifted chest. Movement: drive through the heels to extend the knees and hips while the handles hang by the sides. Return: hinge and bend the knees to lower back into the squat.

185.name: Standing Cable Hip Adduction
185.description: Starting position: stand side-on to a low cable with an ankle cuff on the near leg and hold the frame for balance. Movement: draw the working leg across the body in front of the standing leg. Return: return the leg slowly toward the cable and then change sides.

186.name: Incline Cable Overhead Triceps Extension
186.description: Starting position: lie on an incline bench facing away from a high cable and hold a straight handle overhead with the elbows close to the torso. Movement: keep the upper arms still and extend the elbows with the triceps. Return: bend the elbows slowly under control.

187.name: Standing Cable Judo Chop
187.description: Starting position: stand side-on to a low cable in a wide stance and hold the rope with both hands over the shoulder away from the pulley. Movement: rotate and crunch the torso forward and down, pulling the rope diagonally toward the floor. Return: return slowly, then change sides.

188.name: Lying Low-Cable Triceps Extension
188.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench and hold a low-cable straight handle above the chest with straight arms. Movement: keep the upper arms still and bend the elbows until the handle approaches the forehead. Return: extend the elbows with the triceps while controlling the cable throughout.

189.name: Cable Preacher Curl
189.description: Starting position: sit at a preacher bench facing a low cable, with the upper arms firmly on the pad and a straight handle in hand. Movement: curl the handle toward the shoulders without lifting the elbows. Return: lower it slowly until the arms are straight.

190.name: Standing Cable Rear-Delt Fly
190.description: Starting position: set the cables high and hold the left cable with the right hand and the right cable with the left hand. Movement: open the straight arms back and out to the sides. Return: pause, then bring the handles back under control.

191.name: Low-Cable Reverse Crunch
191.description: Starting position: lie facing a low cable with ankle cuffs attached, hips and knees at 90 degrees. Movement: draw the knees toward the torso and curl the pelvis off the floor. Return: lower the pelvis slowly while keeping abdominal tension.

192.name: Calf-Machine Shrug
192.description: Starting position: stand in a calf machine with the pads over the shoulders and the torso upright. Movement: lift the shoulders toward the ears without using the arms. Return: pause briefly, then lower the shoulders slowly.

193.name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Bench Press
193.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench holding an EZ bar over the chest with a close grip and elbows tucked. Movement: lower the bar slowly to the lower chest while keeping the elbows close. Return: press it back up by extending the elbows with the triceps.

194.name: Decline Close-Grip Press and Skull Crusher
194.description: Starting position: secure the legs on a decline bench and hold a barbell above the chest with a close grip; use a spotter for a safe lift-off. Movement: perform a close-grip press, then keep the upper arms still and lower the bar in an arc toward the forehead. Return: extend the triceps back overhead and alternate the two movements.

195.name: Decline Oblique Crunch
195.description: Starting position: secure the legs on a decline bench with one hand behind the head. Movement: curl the torso up while rotating so the opposite elbow approaches the knee. Return: lower slowly, complete one side, then switch sides.

196.name: Feet-Elevated Push-Up
196.description: Starting position: hold a high plank with the feet on a bench or box and the body in a straight line. Movement: lower the chest toward the floor by bending the elbows. Return: press back up through the chest and keep the body aligned.

197.name: Decline Reverse Crunch
197.description: Starting position: lie on a decline bench, hold its top edge, and keep the legs together and nearly straight. Movement: draw the legs toward the torso while curling the pelvis and lifting the hips from the bench. Return: lower the legs slowly without losing abdominal tension.

198.name: Barbell Hip Thrust
198.description: Starting position: sit on the floor with the upper back against a bench and a padded barbell across the hips. Movement: drive through the feet and extend the hips until supported by the shoulder blades and feet, squeezing the glutes. Return: lower the hips slowly.

199.name: Barbell Lunge
199.description: Starting position: safely unrack a barbell onto the upper back, stand tall, and step away from the rack. Movement: step forward and lower into a lunge with an upright torso; keep the front knee from traveling past the toes. Return: drive through the front heel and repeat on the other leg.

200.name: Rear-Delt Barbell Row
200.description: Starting position: hinge forward with a wide overhand barbell grip, neutral back, and elbows out so the body and arms form a T. Movement: row the bar toward the upper chest, using the rear delts rather than the biceps. Return: lower the bar slowly to the start.

201.name: Barbell Step-Up
201.description: Starting position: stand before a box or bench with a barbell across the upper back. Movement: step onto the platform and extend the working hip and knee, driving mainly through that heel. Return: step down under control and repeat on the other leg.

202.name: One-Arm T-Bar Row
202.description: Starting position: securely anchor one end of a loaded barbell, hinge forward, and hold the sleeve behind the plates with one hand. Movement: row the bar vertically toward the lower chest while keeping the torso still. Return: lower it slowly without letting the plates touch the floor, then change arms.

203.name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Push-Up
203.description: Starting position: hold a high plank with both hands around a vertical dumbbell, elbows tucked, and the body rigid. Movement: lower the body while keeping the back and legs straight and the hips level. Return: press up through the triceps to straight arms.

204.name: Standing Close-Grip Barbell Curl
204.description: Starting position: stand tall with a close underhand barbell grip and the elbows fixed by the sides. Movement: curl the bar toward the shoulders without moving the upper arms. Return: lower it slowly under control.

205.name: Cuban Press
205.description: Starting position: hold only light dumbbells in the scarecrow position, with the upper arms parallel to the floor and the forearms hanging down. Movement: externally rotate until the forearms are vertical, then press the dumbbells overhead. Return: reverse the press and rotation slowly with a light, pain-free load.

206.name: Alternating Dumbbell Curl
206.description: Starting position: stand with a dumbbell in each hand and the elbows close to the torso. Movement: curl one dumbbell toward the shoulder while supinating so the palm faces forward and up, keeping the upper arm still. Return: lower it slowly while rotating the palm back toward the thigh, then alternate arms.

207.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
207.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench with dumbbells above the chest and palms facing each other. Movement: lower the dumbbells beside the chest under control. Return: press them up while keeping the wrists neutral and the shoulders stable.

208.name: Side-Lying One-Arm Rear-Delt Raise
208.description: Starting position: lie on the side on a bench with a light dumbbell in the upper hand and a slight elbow bend. Movement: raise the arm out to the side using the rear deltoid without rolling the torso. Return: lower the dumbbell slowly.

209.name: Incline Prone Rear-Delt Raise
209.description: Starting position: lie chest-down on a low incline bench with dumbbells hanging below the shoulders and a slight elbow bend. Movement: raise the arms out until the elbows reach shoulder height. Return: lower the dumbbells slowly without swinging.

210.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Shoulder Press
210.description: Starting position: stand or sit upright with one dumbbell at shoulder height and the palm facing forward. Movement: press the dumbbell overhead to a straight arm. Return: pause, lower it slowly to the shoulder, then change arms.

211.name: One-Arm Overhead Dumbbell Triceps Extension
211.description: Starting position: hold one dumbbell overhead with the upper arm beside the head. Movement: bend only the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind the head. Return: extend the elbow with the triceps while keeping the upper arm still, then change arms.

212.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Upright Row
212.description: Starting position: stand tall holding a dumbbell in front of the thigh with a neutral back. Movement: pull it close to the body toward chin height, leading with the elbow. Return: lower it slowly and use a comfortable, pain-free range.

213.name: Prone Incline Dumbbell Curl
213.description: Starting position: lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging below the shoulders, palms forward, and elbows by the sides. Movement: curl the dumbbells while keeping the upper arms still. Return: lower until the arms are fully straight.

214.name: Plate Front Raise
214.description: Starting position: stand tall holding a weight plate at its sides with nearly straight arms. Movement: raise the plate in front to just above shoulder height without swinging or further bending the elbows. Return: lower it slowly while keeping the torso still.

215.name: Gironda Sternum Chin-Up
215.description: Starting position: hang from a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip, chest lifted, and torso leaning back. Movement: pull the sternum toward the bar while maintaining the arched position and keeping the head back. Return: lower slowly under control.

216.name: Neutral-Grip Incline Dumbbell Press
216.description: Starting position: lie on an incline bench with dumbbells at shoulder level and palms facing each other. Movement: lower the dumbbells beside the upper chest under control. Return: press them up through the chest, pause, then lower slowly; set the weights down carefully after the set.

217.name: Incline Barbell Skull Crusher
217.description: Starting position: lie on a 45-75 degree incline bench holding a barbell overhead with the upper arms close to the head. Movement: bend only the elbows to lower the bar in an arc behind the head. Return: extend the triceps to bring the bar back overhead.

218.name: Incline Prone Dumbbell Row, Elbows Out
218.description: Starting position: lie chest-down on a 30-degree incline bench with dumbbells hanging below and elbows slightly flared. Movement: row the dumbbells up with the elbows out until the upper arms align with the back. Return: lower them slowly into the stretch.

219.name: Incline Cable Chest Press
219.description: Starting position: sit on an incline bench between cables with the handles at chest level, chest lifted and shoulder blades set. Movement: press the handles straight forward by extending the elbows. Return: pause, then return slowly while maintaining cable tension.

220.name: Lying Heel Touch
220.description: Starting position: lie on the back with knees bent, feet on the floor, and arms by the sides. Movement: slightly curl up and reach to the right heel, then return. Return: reach to the left heel; touching both heels counts as one repetition.

221.name: Alternating Standing Cable Press
221.description: Starting position: stand between low cables with handles raised to shoulder height and palms forward. Movement: press one handle vertically overhead while keeping the chest lifted and head neutral. Return: lower it with control and immediately alternate sides.

222.name: Dumbbell Around-the-World
222.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench with dumbbells beside the thighs, palms up, and a slight bend in the elbows. Movement: sweep the dumbbells in a wide arc from the thighs to behind the head, keeping the arms parallel to the floor. Return: reverse the arc slowly back to the thighs.

223.name: Barbell Roll-In Pike
223.description: Starting position: hold a high plank on a lightly loaded Olympic barbell. Movement: keep a natural back position, lift the hips, and roll the bar toward the feet with straight arms and a braced core. Return: roll the bar forward slowly back to the plank.

224.name: Barbell Glute Bridge
224.description: Starting position: lie on the floor with knees bent and a padded barbell across the hips. Movement: drive through the heels and extend the hips vertically until the upper back and heels support the body. Return: squeeze the glutes at the top, then lower slowly.

225.name: Guillotine Neck Press
225.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell over the neck with a medium grip. Movement: lower the bar slowly to just above the neck using a controlled, pain-free range. Return: press it back up through the chest; use a spotter because this variation carries elevated risk.

226.name: Barbell Hack Squat
226.description: Starting position: stand holding a barbell behind the body with straight arms and a neutral back. Movement: squat down while keeping the chest up and the back straight. Return: drive through the heels to stand and repeat under control.

227.name: Head-Supported Bent-Over Dumbbell Fly
227.description: Starting position: hinge in front of an incline bench with the forehead supported, back neutral, and dumbbells hanging beneath the shoulders. Movement: raise the nearly straight arms out to the sides without swinging or pulling them backward. Return: pause, then lower slowly.

228.name: Seated Machine Chest Press
228.description: Starting position: sit in the chest-press machine with the handles at chest level, elbows bent, chest lifted, and shoulder blades set. Movement: press the handles straight forward. Return: pause at lockout and return slowly while keeping tension; the movement may also be performed unilaterally where supported.

229.name: Incline Cable Pullover
229.description: Starting position: lie on an incline bench facing away from a high cable, holding a straight handle near the thighs with straight arms. Movement: raise the handle in an arc overhead under control while keeping the shoulders stable. Return: use the lats to bring the handle back toward the thighs and pause in the contracted position.

230.name: Cable Shoulder Internal Rotation
230.description: Starting position: sit side-on to a low cable with the near elbow fixed to the side at 90 degrees. Movement: rotate the forearm across the abdomen while keeping it parallel to the floor. Return: rotate slowly back to the cable and then change arms.

231.name: One-Arm Reverse-Grip Cable Triceps Pressdown
231.description: Starting position: face a high cable, hold a D-handle with an underhand grip, and keep the upper arm fixed at the side. Movement: extend the elbow to press the handle down. Return: raise it slowly while keeping the shoulder still, then change arms.

232.name: Seated Cable Rope High Row
232.description: Starting position: sit at a low-row station with a rope handle, straight back, arms extended, and elbows flared. Movement: pull the rope toward the upper chest just below the neck while keeping the elbows high. Return: extend the arms slowly and allow only a slight shoulder reach.

233.name: Cable Russian Twist
233.description: Starting position: lie with the upper back across a stability ball, hips high, and hold a mid-height cable handle above the chest with both hands. Movement: brace the abs and rotate the torso a quarter turn away from the cable. Return: rotate back slowly under tension, then change sides.

234.name: Seated Cable Lateral Raise
234.description: Starting position: sit on a bench between two low cables, lean forward with the chest on the thighs, and cross-grip the handles under the knees. Movement: raise the arms out and up until the upper arms are parallel to the floor, keeping a fixed slight elbow bend. Return: lower slowly.

235.name: Dumbbell Handle Calf Raise
235.description: Starting position: hold a stable support and place one foot on the handle of a round-ended dumbbell, allowing the heel to stretch. Movement: rise as high as possible onto the ball of the foot, rolling the dumbbell only in a controlled manner. Return: lower the heel slowly and change legs.

236.name: Close-Grip Barbell Bench Press
236.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench with a barbell over the chest, hands just inside shoulder width, and elbows close to the torso. Movement: lower the bar to the lower chest under control. Return: press it back up by extending the elbows with the triceps.

237.name: Close-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
237.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench holding dumbbells together above the chest with neutral grips and elbows tucked. Movement: lower the dumbbells while keeping them close together and the shoulders stable. Return: press them back up through the triceps and chest.

238.name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl
238.description: Starting position: stand tall holding an EZ bar on its inner bends with an underhand grip and elbows by the sides. Movement: curl the bar toward the shoulders without moving the upper arms. Return: lower it slowly through a controlled range.

239.name: Cross-Body Hammer Curl
239.description: Starting position: stand with dumbbells at the sides and palms facing inward. Movement: curl one dumbbell diagonally across the torso toward the opposite shoulder while keeping the elbow close. Return: lower slowly and alternate arms.

240.name: Decline EZ-Bar Skull Crusher
240.description: Starting position: secure the legs on a decline bench and hold an EZ bar above the chest with the upper arms still. Movement: bend the elbows to lower the bar toward the forehead in a controlled arc. Return: extend the elbows with the triceps; use a safe load and a spotter when needed.

241.name: Incline Prone Dumbbell Row, Elbows In
241.description: Starting position: lie chest-down on an incline bench with dumbbells hanging below the shoulders and elbows close to the torso. Movement: row the dumbbells toward the hips while keeping the chest on the pad. Return: lower them slowly to a full stretch without swinging.

242.name: Dumbbell Scaption Raise
242.description: Starting position: stand with light dumbbells at the sides in a neutral, thumbs-up grip. Movement: raise the arms in the scapular plane, about 30 degrees forward of the sides, to shoulder height while keeping the thumbs up. Return: lower slowly in the same neutral grip; keep the load light and use a pain-free range.

243.name: Dumbbell Step-Up
243.description: Starting position: stand before a sturdy box or bench holding dumbbells at the sides. Movement: step onto the platform and extend the working hip and knee by driving through that heel. Return: step down under control and repeat on the other leg.

244.name: Classic EZ-Bar Curl
244.description: Starting position: stand tall holding an EZ bar on the outer bends with the elbows close to the torso. Movement: curl the bar until the biceps fully contract without moving the upper arms. Return: pause briefly, then lower the bar slowly.

245.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
245.description: Starting position: kneel with both hands on an ab wheel placed in front of the knees. Movement: roll forward into a straight body line as far as the core can control without touching the floor. Return: pull the wheel back with the abdominals while keeping the core braced.

246.name: Arnold Press
246.description: Starting position: sit with back support and hold dumbbells at the upper chest with palms facing the body. Movement: press overhead while rotating the palms forward. Return: lower the dumbbells while rotating the palms back toward the body.

247.name: Resistance Band Pull-Apart
247.description: Starting position: stand tall holding a resistance band with straight arms in front of the chest. Movement: pull the hands apart until the band reaches the chest, squeezing the shoulder blades and drawing the shoulders back. Return: return slowly under tension.

248.name: Barbell Walking Lunge
248.description: Starting position: stand with a barbell across the upper back and feet hip-width apart. Movement: take a long step forward and lower until the rear knee nearly touches the floor, keeping the front knee behind the toes. Return: drive through the front heel and continue by lunging with the other leg.

249.name: Bench Dip
249.description: Starting position: face away from a bench with hands on its edge, arms straight, legs extended, and heels on the floor. Movement: lower the body by bending the elbows to just below 90 degrees, keeping them close and pointing back. Return: press back up with the triceps.

250.name: Barbell Pullover
250.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench holding a barbell above the chest with a fixed slight elbow bend. Movement: lower the bar in an arc behind the head until the chest and back stretch comfortably. Return: pull it back along the same arc to above the chest.

251.name: Barbell Box Squat
251.description: Starting position: set a box in a power rack, unrack a barbell onto the upper back, and stand with a braced back. Movement: sit back and down until fully seated on the box, knees tracking out; never bounce off the box. Return: drive through the heels to stand.

252.name: Cable Rope Curl
252.description: Starting position: face a low cable holding the rope with neutral grips and elbows fixed to the sides. Movement: curl the rope until the forearms approach the biceps, moving only at the elbows. Return: pause, then lower the rope slowly.

253.name: High-Cable Fly
253.description: Starting position: stand between high cables holding D-handles with the chest lifted and arms out in a T, keeping a slight elbow bend. Movement: sweep the handles down and together in front of the hips. Return: pause, then open the arms slowly under control.

254.name: Overhead Cable Rope Triceps Extension
254.description: Starting position: hold a rope from a low cable overhead with neutral grips, elbows close to the head, and upper arms vertical. Movement: bend the elbows to lower the rope behind the head. Return: extend the elbows with the triceps while keeping the upper arms still.

255.name: Barbell Clean and Jerk
255.description: Starting position: stand close to the bar with a neutral back, chest lifted, hips down, and a secure overhand or hook grip. Movement: pull from the floor, explosively extend, then drop under into a deep front squat, turning the elbows through to receive the bar in the front rack; stand fully before the jerk. Dip and drive, receive the bar locked out overhead in a split stance, then recover to a stable standing position before lowering under control.

256.name: Barbell Clean and Press
256.description: Starting position: stand with the bar close to the shins, feet shoulder-width apart, back neutral, and shoulders slightly ahead of the bar. Movement: pull explosively, drop under into a squat clean, turn the elbows through to the front rack, and absorb the catch through the knees and hips; stand fully before pressing overhead. Return: lower the bar to the chest and then to the floor under control.

257.name: Cross-Body Crunch
257.description: Starting position: lie on the back with knees bent, feet flat, and hands lightly behind the head. Movement: lift one shoulder blade and bring the opposite knee toward it, aiming the elbow toward the knee without pulling on the neck. Return: lower slowly and alternate sides.

258.name: Decline Dumbbell Bench Press
258.description: Starting position: secure the legs on a decline bench and hold dumbbells above the chest with palms forward. Movement: lower the dumbbells beside the torso under control, keeping the forearms perpendicular to the floor. Return: press up through the chest and lower with a slower eccentric.

259.name: Decline Dumbbell Fly
259.description: Starting position: secure the legs on a decline bench and hold dumbbells above the chest with nearly straight arms and palms facing each other. Movement: open the arms in a wide arc until the chest stretches, keeping a slight elbow bend to protect the joints. Return: sweep the arms back together through the chest.

260.name: Barbell Drag Curl
260.description: Starting position: hold a barbell with an underhand grip, elbows close to the torso and slightly behind it. Movement: curl the bar upward while dragging it along the body and letting the elbows travel back without shrugging. Return: lower the bar slowly while maintaining contact with the torso.

261.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
261.description: Starting position: lie on the floor with dumbbells held above the body. Movement: lower until the upper arms touch the floor; keep the elbows closer for more triceps emphasis or wider for more chest emphasis. Return: pause, then press the dumbbells to straight arms.

262.name: Cable Shoulder External Rotation
262.description: Starting position: stand side-on to a cable at elbow height with the working arm farther from the pulley, elbow fixed to the side at 90 degrees. Movement: rotate the forearm away from the cable while keeping the elbow pinned. Return: return slowly through a comfortable range.

263.name: Cable Face Pull
263.description: Starting position: face a high cable with a rope or two D-handles. Movement: pull the handles toward the face while separating the ends and keeping the upper arms parallel to the floor. Return: extend the arms slowly under control.

264.name: Lying Low-Cable Fly
264.description: Starting position: lie on a flat bench between low cables with D-handles, palms up, a slight elbow bend, and the feet planted. Movement: sweep the arms in a wide arc until the handles meet above the chest. Return: lower the arms slowly while preserving the elbow angle.

265.name: Barbell Floor Press
265.description: Starting position: lie on the floor in a power rack with the barbell over the chest and shoulder blades set. Movement: lower the bar to the lower chest or upper abdomen until the upper arms touch the floor; pause without bouncing. Return: press up quickly while keeping wrists, forearms, and elbows aligned.

266.name: Front Squat
266.description: Starting position: support a barbell on the front deltoids with a clean grip, elbows high, chest lifted, and feet about shoulder-width apart. Movement: squat between the legs while the knees track with the toes. Return: drive through the heels or mid-foot to stand, keeping the elbows high.

267.name: Goblet Squat
267.description: Starting position: stand tall holding a kettlebell by the horns close to the chest. Movement: squat down between the legs with the chest up and back straight; use the elbows to gently guide the knees out at the bottom. Return: stand up under control.

268.name: Barbell Good Morning
268.description: Starting position: hold a barbell across the upper back, brace the back, keep the knees slightly bent, and step clear of the rack. Movement: hinge at the hips until the torso is nearly parallel to the floor, maintaining a neutral spine. Return: extend the hips with the glutes and hamstrings to stand.

269.name: Hyperextension
269.description: Starting position: lie face-down on a hyperextension bench with the ankles secured and the upper pad supporting the thighs while the hips can bend freely. Movement: lower the torso with a straight back only to a comfortable hamstring stretch; never round the spine. Return: raise to a straight line without hyperextending or using momentum.
